Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 13
Reason for Mistake: The Planner made a critical error in synthesizing the data from the Baseball-Reference source. In Step 13, the Planner observed that the "Longest Winning Streak" on the 1916 New York Giants schedule page was listed as 26 games, but noted that this span included a tie game. The Planner then incorrectly concluded that the "uninterrupted wins-only run is shorter" and subsequently stated the all-time record is 22 games (the Cleveland Indians' 2017 streak). This is a factual error because the 1916 New York Giants' 26-game streak is widely recognized as the MLB record for the longest winning streak (where a tie does not break the streak, per MLB rules). The Planner failed to correctly interpret the definition of a "winning streak" in baseball (which includes ties) and incorrectly dismissed the 26-game record in favor of the 22-game "wins-only" record, leading to an incorrect final answer.
